title: Compatible sections over an initial pointed etale diagram
statement: Let S and T be schemes, s:Spec(Omega) -> S a geometric point, g:T -> S, and N:I -> (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.Elements an initial functor from a small category. A pointed etale section cone consists of sections sigma_i:T -> T times_S N(i), natural in i. For an abelian etale sheaf F on S, form the component restriction by applying the inverse-image adjunction unit at N(i), restricting along sigma_i, and identifying evaluation at the terminal etale object with global sections. There is a unique morphism F_s -> Gamma(T,g^*F) whose composite with each germ at N(i) is this component restriction. No local-ring, limit, properness, torsion, or isomorphism hypothesis on g is imposed.

proof.text: Store initiality of N and its compatible pullback sections. Define component restriction by the inverse-image unit, restriction along the section, and the canonical terminal-evaluation/global-sections isomorphism. Define IsRestriction by its germ-component equations.

By Mathlib Point.isColimitPresheafFiberCocone the stalk cocone is a colimit. N.op is final; Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv makes the restricted cocone a colimit. Naturality of the adjunction unit and sigma proves compatibility of the component restrictions. IsColimit.desc, fac, and hom_ext give existence, the component equations, and uniqueness.
